scope: Dataset-203 fixed four-chain 256/512 frozen nonlinear metric candidate; cached completed refined-ladder baseline; not independent calibration

field.metric: Frozen nonlinear low-rank Gauss-Newton (parent-pinned metric files)

rescaling.target: Full positive-beta posterior plus real-coordinate Jacobian

prior_replica: Fresh independent standard-Gaussian white and bounded-uniform physical scalars each sweep; base likelihood evaluated for swaps
local_seeds: Layout 3: 0x5300000000000000 | mock_id<<32 | ensemble<<30 | replica<<24 | outer_index<<4 | purpose
swaps: Four alternating disjoint neighbor passes per outer sweep, parity=(outer_index+pass_index)%2; same complete-state exchange rule
roundtrip: Measured walker visits cold, actually refreshes at beta=0, then returns cold; observe after every pass, count no unrefreshed prior bounce
replay: Ensemble 0: copy after warmup+32; resume 16 sweeps; compare complete checkpoint, summary and retained draws 32..47; exclude replay
stopping: Stop each cohort at four chains of 256 warmup and 512 retained draws, even on failure; no extension, dropping, replacement or retuning
limits: Only beta=1 records are cold posterior draws
Labels measure walker transport, not unchanged physical configurations
Path-barrier reduction does not certify energy overlap
Serial validation format, not production MPI ensemble checkpointing
Five scalar and six field projection diagnostics; not all field coordinates
Synthetic same-model target; no coverage or real-catalog claim
Fixed four-chain budget: report failure without extending or retuning
comparison: Fresh candidate versus immutable completed 13-replica baseline; same target, starts, replica-index seeds, ladder and all kernels except field mass. Wall times measured under different concurrency and not compared as a speedup.
